# Baghdad 830 – Life sciences

- **Microorganisms (living things too small to see)** [`microorganisms`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/microorganisms.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. There are no lenses of any kind, only burning mirrors in Greek books and rock crystal. Without a microscope there is nothing to show.
- **Life comes only from life (spontaneous generation refuted)** [`spontaneous_generation_refuted`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/spontaneous_generation_refuted.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Everyone, from Aristotle's readers to the date farmers, knows that worms come from rot and flies from dung. A covered jar beside an open one is an easy experiment no one has thought to make.
- **Fermentation is the work of living yeast** [`fermentation_yeast`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/fermentation_yeast.md) — K0, use partial, make hard, accept medium. Wine is forbidden but drunk at court and in the Christian monasteries; jurists debate which date drinks (nabidh) are lawful once they ferment. Bakers keep leaven, cooks make vinegar and murri. Yeast as a living thing needs a microscope. Local: Christian monasteries around Baghdad, praised by later poets for their wine; Hanafi jurists on nabidh.

- **Systematic classification and naming of living things** [`taxonomy`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/taxonomy.md) — K2, use partial, make easy, accept high. Aristotle's books on animals are known in an early Arabic version, and Dioscorides' herbal circulates in Syriac. Philologists collect the names of camels, horses and plants from Bedouin informants. Order is by use or alphabet, not by kinship. Local: philologists of Basra and Kufa; druggists' herbals; al-Jahiz.
- **Egg, sperm and fertilisation** [`reproduction_fertilisation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/reproduction_fertilisation.md) — K2, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Every date farmer pollinates female palms by hand with male flowers, so plant sex is common knowledge. For humans Galen's two seeds compete with Aristotle's form and matter. The egg is unknown. Local: date growers of the Sawad and Basra.
- **Heredity by discrete factors (Mendel)** [`heredity_genetics`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/heredity_genetics.md) — K1, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Arabs keep pedigrees of horses and camels as carefully as of tribes; Hisham ibn al-Kalbi (d. c. 820) wrote on the genealogies of horses. Breeders select by eye and lineage; no discrete factors, no ratios. Local: horse breeders of the caliph's stables.
- **Evolution by natural selection** [`evolution_natural_selection`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/evolution_natural_selection.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Species are fixed by God's creation. Al-Jahiz, alive and writing, notices how animals compete for food and adapt to places; his Book of Animals comes around 847. Modern claims that he had a theory of evolution are overstated. Local: al-Jahiz.

- **Breathing is slow combustion (respiration and body heat)** [`respiration_metabolism`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/respiration_metabolism.md) — K1, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Galen teaches that breath cools the innate heat of the heart and feeds the vital spirit; a lamp in a closed jar goes out, and nobody connects the two.
- **Plants are built from air, water and light (photosynthesis and mineral nutrition)** [`photosynthesis_plant_nutrition`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/photosynthesis_plant_nutrition.md) — K0, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Plants are thought to draw their food from soil and water. Farmers of the Sawad manure with dung and pigeon droppings and know that saline water kills crops.
- **Legumes fix nitrogen from the air (root nodule bacteria)** [`nitrogen_fixation_biology`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nitrogen_fixation_biology.md) — K0, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Broad beans, lentils, chickpeas and clover are grown; that they restore a field is known from Greek and Persian farm lore, without reason.
- **The brain and nerves (seat of thought, electrical signalling)** [`nervous_system_brain`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nervous_system_brain.md) — K2, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Galen's doctrine is standard among the court physicians. The brain makes psychic spirit and sends it through hollow nerves; the eye sends out a visual spirit. Aristotle's heart-centred view survives among philosophers. Local: Yuhanna ibn Masawayh; Hunayn ibn Ishaq, later the author of Ten Treatises on the Eye.
